items.title: Sam Darnold: In uniform for unofficial practice
items.text:
Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) was suited up for Monday's unofficial practice, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.

items.title: Micah Parsons: Reportedly gains clearance to return
items.text:
